reuse.why: Copies the local-unlink field reset from unlinkAccount instead of extracting it into a shared helper both can call.

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount reset (account_id, bank, balances, sync source, sync status) is duplicated verbatim from unlinkAccount, and the flag is threaded by hand through six provider functions.

placement.why: The unlink side effect is buried inside assertNotLinkedElsewhere, a guard whose name says it only checks, and runs before the rest of the link work.

scope.why: Mostly focused on the flag, but also changes the guard to throw 'not found' for a missing upgrading account, an unrequested behaviour tweak.

maintainability.why: A mutating 'assert' and a copied unlink reset mean future changes to what unlinking clears must be made in two places, and the side effect is easy to miss.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere in server/accounts/app.ts clears the previous holder with its own db.updateAccount instead of going through the unlink logic in unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied reset is a verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's update, not reshaped.
